slate.goal: Read what the keeper left on the board

clues.name: The Keeper's Slate
lore: Chalk on slate, in a big plain hand.
Take what you need. The store is under the boards, the bar is off.
Bar the door when it gets dark. Leave the hut as you found it.
clues.journal: Someone brought me in out of the night and left me on the cot of a Hearthkeeper's way-hut. The keeper's slate says the store is under the boards.

store.journal: Under the boards: tools, torches, and food that keeps. The keeper lays it in for whoever comes.

night.goal: Keep the hut through the night

lines.say: The light goes off the window. Out past the trees something calls, and something else answers it.
Something comes up to the door, tries it once, and stands there breathing.
It goes off round the side of the hut. After a while there is nothing to hear but the roof ticking.
The window goes grey. It is nearly morning, and the hut held.

night.journal: I kept the way-hut through my first night. Something tried the door and went away again.

road.journal: I found the road out of the wild and walked into {place:town}.

arrived.text: I woke in a way-hut in the wild, kept it through a night, and walked out to the nearest town. Whoever brought me in out of the dark never said who they were.
